blocks.text: Filipino-American activist Bea Millan-Windorski hopes to bring out the Filipinos’ “bayanihan” spirit for her campaign to score the Philippines’ fifth victory in the Miss Universe 2026 pageant as it releases the delegates’ official headshots on its app for online voting. “LABAN [Philippine flag emoji][universe emoji] The Miss Universe Fan Vote has officially begun!” the beauty queen posted on social media as she shared her headshot. View this post on Instagram A post shared by Bea Millan-Windorski 💫 (@bea.millan.windorski) In the image, Windorski was in a simple white tube top, and her long black hair was kept straight to frame her face.
